# Code of Conduct

We are committed to providing a welcoming, respectful, and harassment-free experience for everyone who contributes to or uses Omo workflows.

## Expected behavior

- Be kind, constructive, and respectful of differing viewpoints and experience levels.
- Give and receive feedback professionally.
- Focus on the work and its impact, not on people.
- Respect privacy and do not share personal information, credentials, or private learner data.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, discrimination, intimidation, personal attacks, sexualized language or imagery, doxxing, deliberate disruption, and publishing private information without permission are not acceptable. Retaliation against anyone who reports a concern or participates in a review is also not acceptable.

## Reporting

Report unacceptable behavior privately to the project maintainers. Include enough context to investigate, and avoid reposting private or sensitive information in a public issue.

Maintainers will review reports in good faith, protect the reporter's privacy where possible, and take whatever action they consider appropriate, including removing content or restricting participation.

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/). It applies alongside the MIT license and the contribution rules for each repository.
